demo.program:
# Go — self-test quiz demo
qa = [
    ("Who created Go?", "Google (Griesemer, Pike, Thompson)"),
    ("What paradigm is Go?", "procedural, concurrent"),
    ("What is creator?", "Google (Griesemer, Pike, Thompson)"),
    ("What is first appeared?", "2009"),
    ("What is paradigm?", "procedural, concurrent"),
    ("What is typing?", "static"),
    ("What is file extension?", ".go"),
    ("What is hello world?", "fmt.Println(\"Hello, world!\")"),
]
score = 0
for i, (q, a) in enumerate(qa, 1):
    print(f"Q{i}: {q}")
    ans = input("Your answer: ").strip().lower()
    if ans and ans in a.lower():
        print("Correct.")
        score += 1
    else:
        print(f"Answer: {a}")
print(f"Score: {score}/{len(qa)}")
